sara_prod: Heads-up — OnPrem 2.5 is released with two features for compliance customers: Privacy-safe-mode (opt-in runtime that strips telemetry & PII) and a Cross-Border Transfer Playbook for customers operating across regions. Docs + rollout plan here: https://redwood.internal/docs/onprem/2.5-privacy-playbook

josh_ops: Nice. When does GA begin for customers? any migration window?

sara_prod: GA available today for new installs. Existing OnPrem 2.x customers: opt-in upgrade starts next Monday (2026-03-30). There's a 30-day opt-in window; auto-upgrade only if customer consents. See rollout section in the doc.

jane_legal: Note: customers in EU/APAC requiring data residency must sign the Data Transfer Addendum. Legal has a template linked in the doc. @sara_prod please confirm requirement is surfaced in the onboarding flow.

sara_prod: Confirmed. The onboarding flow will show a required checkbox + DTA link. Example config snippet for ops:
```
redwood:
  privacy_safe_mode: true
  telemetry: disabled
  cross_border_policy: strict
```

deploy-bot: deploy started: onprem-2.5/privacy-playbook v1 -> infra-cluster-7 :white_check_mark:

csp-team: Can we get a customer readiness checklist (one-pager) to share with early adopters? Also request a webinar for partners.

sara_prod: Putting together a one-pager + partner webinar next Wed 10am PT. Draft checklist + slide deck: https://redwood.docs/papers/onprem-2.5-readiness (internal). I'll ping when the invite is up.

josh_ops: There's a small UI bug in the console toggle (it flips but doesn't persist in some sessions). Can we patch before wide GA?

sara_prod: Filed bug #INV-4321, hotfix targeted EOD today. If anyone sees regressions after upgrade, please tag me and post logs with `--trace`.

terry_ceo: Huge thanks to the team 🎉 This should help close several compliance deals. Great work.

jane_legal: Adding: make sure marketing copy doesn't imply "data never leaves country" unless customer has isolated region deployment and DTA signed. I'll review the external assets.

sara_prod: Noted. Will coordinate with marketing/legal. Thanks all. :rocket:
